scope.summary: The added dictionary-size initialization is reached by the existing .lzma decoding route. The supplied build, input, lifecycle, and control-flow contracts support sufficiency for this change.

assessments.reason: A valid .lzma input of at least 26 bytes with a header within the 300 MiB limit puts the complete 13-byte header in the helper’s first input segment. Header parsing then invokes the LZMA decoder, which reaches the added assignment on fresh allocation.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parsed .lzma header selects and initializes the LZMA1EXT decoder.
The filter helper invokes the selected initializer.
The selected initializer calls the changed LZ decoder initializer.
The default CMake decoder configuration includes LZMA1 and the changed source file.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The helper supplies the first half of the input before refilling and calls lzma_code.
The recipe builds the default CMake liblzma target and invokes the fuzz-target Makefile.

build.reason: The recipe builds static liblzma, copies its archive to the path used by the fuzz-target Makefile, and invokes that Makefile. CMake’s default decoder list includes LZMA1 and its source.

evidence.dependency_reason: These rules include the changed decoder in the library built by the recipe.

input.reason: The entry passes generated bytes to the .lzma decoder. For a valid stream at least 26 bytes long, the helper’s first segment contains its full 13-byte header, allowing decoder initialization before any refill.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser consumes the header fields and initializes the decoder when the memory limit permits.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes a fresh stream, checks initialization, decodes, and calls lzma_end. The initializer sets decoder state, and lzma_end releases the coder chain.

This is the cleanup called by the entry.

control_flow.reason: The public initializer installs alone_decode; lzma_code invokes it. A complete acceptable header selects LZMA1EXT, whose initializer calls lzma_lz_decoder_init and executes the added assignment on fresh allocation.
